title: Promoted, Allegedly
logline: A overheard half-sentence about Ryan turns into office-wide rumor, while Michael seeks Toby's dating advice at a client lunch and Dwight sabotages the temp.
outline: A: Michael, wanting Jan, asks Toby for advice at a client lunch offsite and fantasizes firing him. B: Dwight sabotages Ryan after a telephone-game rumor says Ryan's been promoted; Angela covers. C: Ryan briefly treated as boss; Jim and Pam pass the rumor along and Pam draws. Order: cold, A, B, C, A, B, C, A, B, A, tag
theme: Everyone wants to be chosen, and everyone hears what they fear.
storySoFar: Michael's dinner with Jan was canceled; Jan mocked his costume then softened. Ryan pitched David Wallace; Jan hinted corporate interest. Dwight campaigns for Assistant Regional Manager, holds a Champion ribbon. Jim holds a real beet. Pam keeps Jim's lamp on, attends art class; Roy keeps canceling. Ep 8: a garbled rumor says Ryan was promoted; Dwight sabotaged Ryan with Angela's cover; Michael asked Toby for date advice at a client lunch and fantasized firing him; Ryan's actual news was a corporate lunch invitation from Jan.

stateChanges.progress: Rumor of promotion spreads; real news is Jan wants to meet Ryan about corporate. Michael half-knows and lets him go to the lunch.
Dwight sabotaged Ryan's phone and files; Angela covered for him. Still no title.
Michael asked Toby for advice, imagined firing him; Toby kept his job and gave decent advice. Jan dinner still open.

stateChanges.text: Telephone-game rumor: 'Ryan got promoted' started as 'Ryan got prompted.'
Ryan has a lunch with Jan at corporate next week.

scenes.recap: Jim tells Dwight a sentence one word at a time through Pam and Creed.

beats.text: Pam, tell Dwight the fax machine is hungry.
Dwight, Jim says the fax machine is angry.
Question: why would a fax machine be angry? Did someone insult it?
I once insulted a fax machine in Macau. Never saw that guy again.

lines: I just wanted to see how far a sentence goes. Turns out, not very.

scenes.recap: Michael invites Toby, of all people, to a client lunch and asks for relationship advice.

beats.text: Toby. I need you at the Alfredo's client lunch. You're driving. And you are also advising.
Advising on what?
Hypothetically, a man loves a woman who is his boss. Hypothetically, it's me and Jan.
I'd say be honest, and maybe not do anything in the office.
Wow. Great. So, lie and hide. Thank you, HR.

lines: He asked for my advice. I've waited years for that. I'm going to be so careful.

scenes.recap: Ryan takes a call and the rumor starts.

beats.text: Jan's office. Yes. Thursday. I'd be honored to be prompted.

beats.caption: hangs up and smirks at his phone

beats.text: Ryan got promoted?
Actually, I heard 'prompted.' Which isn't a thing.
Ryan is boss.
Ryan's... boss?

scenes.recap: Dwight hears the rumor from Phyllis and panics.

beats.text: Dwight, did you hear? Ryan got promoted. Over you, I think.
False. That is impossible. I am Assistant to the Regional Manager.
Angela. Ryan must be neutralized. I need an alibi, starting now.
I saw nothing. I always see nothing. Nothing is my favorite thing.

lines: Ryan has been here six months. I have been here nine years. Hypothetically, I would never sabotage a temp. But if I did, it would be perfect.

scenes.recap: At the client lunch Michael practices dating lines on Toby.

beats.text: Okay, Toby, you be Jan. Hello Michael, you look handsome.
Hello Michael. You look... handsome.
Stop. You sound sad. Jan is never sad. She is mysteriously unavailable.
Maybe just ask her if she's free for coffee. Low pressure.
Low pressure. Yes. Like a tire. That's a good point and I hate it.

beats.caption: stares into his soda, imagining firing Toby

beats.text: Toby Flenderson, you're fired. Pack your sad little box. Goodbye, forever.
Michael, did you say that out loud?
No. Eat your breadsticks.

scenes.recap: Dwight sabotages Ryan's desk and Angela lies for him.

beats.caption: unplugs Ryan's monitor and swaps his stapler

beats.text: Ryan! Did you get promoted? Are you rich now? Can we go to Cancun?
I was invited to something. It's not a thing yet.
My computer is dead. And my phone list is gone.
Dwight was with me all morning. Discussing cats. Eleven hours.
It's ten-fifteen.
It was a very long cat conversation.

scenes.recap: Jim and Pam watch the rumor mutate; Pam shows Jim a drawing.

beats.text: I heard Ryan's the new regional manager and Michael is moving to Utica.
That's... remarkable, considering it started as 'prompted'.
I don't care. Tell him Pretzel Day stays.
I drew the whole rumor. See? Telephone wires, and Ryan with a crown.
You gave Dwight a tiny crown too. Good call.

beats.caption: a look that lasts a beat too long

lines: It's nice when someone looks at your drawing like it matters. That's all. It's just nice.

scenes.recap: Michael returns to a chaotic office, hears the rumor, and confronts Ryan.

beats.text: Michael, Ryan is trying to take your job. I have evidence. It is mostly feelings.
Ryan. Are you my boss now?
No. Jan invited me to lunch at corporate. To talk about my future.
Okay. Well. That's... great. Go to the lunch. Wear the good tie.
Michael, he is a mole.
Dwight, be quiet. Fix Ryan's computer. Now.
I... it might already be plugged back in.

scenes.recap: Dwight's guilt and a Jell-O reveal.

beats.text: I lied for you. You owe me. Kitten food. A year of it.
Agreed. Also, I love you, in a strictly professional way.
I heard that. I've said it to a hostage before.

beats.caption: opens drawer, finds stapler in lime Jell-O

beats.text: Creed!

scenes.recap: Michael thanks Toby and calls Jan.

beats.text: Toby. Your advice was... fine. Don't let it go to your head.
Thanks, Michael. That means more than you know.

beats.caption: dials Jan, hangs up, dials again

beats.text: Jan. It's Michael. Coffee. Low pressure. Like a tire.

beats.caption: a very long silence on the line

beats.text: She said maybe. I'm going to be sick. It was a great maybe.

lines: Ryan is leaving, and Jan said maybe. A man can only lose and win so much in one day.

beats.text: Pam, tell Dwight the beets are ready.
Dwight, Jim says your feet are ready.
My feet have been ready since birth.
